faqs.q: What is the expansion ring fire hose coupling, 1" to 2-1/2" used for?
faqs.a: This is a threaded fire hose coupling attached by expanding a metal ring inside the hose bore, which locks the hose jacket against the coupling bowl. It is the common way to couple jacketed fire hose and small lay flat hose with US-pattern threads.

faqs.q: What sizes does the expansion ring fire hose coupling, 1" to 2-1/2" come in?
faqs.a: It covers DN25 to DN65 (1" to 2-1/2"). The threads are NST (National Standard Thread), NPSH or BAT, and every coupling is leak-tested. Send the hose bore and thread pattern you need.

faqs.q: What is the expansion ring fire hose coupling, 1" to 2-1/2" made from?
faqs.a: The body is anodised aluminium, stainless steel, brass or PP, and the attachment is a brass expansion ring expanded with a hose expander.

faqs.q: What pressure is the expansion ring fire hose coupling, 1" to 2-1/2" rated for?
faqs.a: The working pressure is not published as a single figure for the expansion ring fire hose coupling, 1" to 2-1/2", and the line is limited by the lower of the hose and coupling ratings. Send the hose bore, type and working pressure and we confirm the rating with the quotation.

faqs.q: Is the expansion ring fire hose coupling, 1" to 2-1/2" tested or approved?
faqs.a: The manufacturer lists FM approval for this coupling. Ask for the certificate for the size and material you order, and we confirm it with the quotation. Every coupling is leak-tested.

faqs.q: What does the expansion ring fire hose coupling, 1" to 2-1/2" connect to?
faqs.a: It connects to the hydrant, pump or the mating half with NST, NPSH or BAT threads, and to fire hose or small lay flat hose on the shank. Tell us the thread and the mating connection when you enquire.

faqs.q: How do I fit the expansion ring fire hose coupling, 1" to 2-1/2" to lay flat hose?
faqs.a: Fit it by expanding the brass expansion ring inside the hose bore with a hose expander so the hose jacket locks against the coupling bowl. Check the working pressure of both the hose and the coupling, since the line is limited by the lower of the two.

faqs.q: Where is the expansion ring fire hose coupling, 1" to 2-1/2" used?
faqs.a: The expansion ring coupling is used on fire hose, civil engineering, industrial and petrochemical hose lines, and with the [jacketed fire hoses](/c/jacketed-fire-hoses).

faqs.q: How does the expansion ring fire hose coupling, 1" to 2-1/2" compare with the nearest alternative?
faqs.a: Use the expansion ring coupling for jacketed fire hose and small lay flat hose; the large-bore couplings such as the [grooved lay flat coupling](/p/large-bore-lay-flat-grooved-coupling) use bolted clamp halves instead.

faqs.q: What do I send to order the expansion ring fire hose coupling, 1" to 2-1/2"?

faqs.q: What is the high-pressure lay flat hose coupling, male × female used for?
faqs.a: This is a coupling built for the pressures of pumped lay flat mains: frac water transfer, high-head dewatering and oil or fuel transfer lines. The male and female halves lock together and are held by a bolted clamp on each hose end.

faqs.q: What sizes does the high-pressure lay flat hose coupling, male × female come in?
faqs.a: It covers DN100 to DN300 (4" to 12"), with an opposite half of the same size as the mating connection. Specify the bore of the TPU lay flat hose you run.

faqs.q: What is the high-pressure lay flat hose coupling, male × female made from?
faqs.a: The body is gravity-cast aluminium, zinc plated, with bolted hose clamp halves. Each coupling is cleaned ultrasonically before assembly.

faqs.q: What pressure is the high-pressure lay flat hose coupling, male × female rated for?
faqs.a: It is built for the pressures of pumped lay flat mains, but the listing gives no figure. The line is limited by the lower of the hose and coupling ratings, so send your working pressure and we confirm it with the quotation.

faqs.q: Is the high-pressure lay flat hose coupling, male × female tested or approved?
faqs.a: Every coupling is air leak-tested and cleaned ultrasonically before assembly. The listing gives no pressure rating figure; confirm the rating with the quotation against your hose class.

faqs.q: What does the high-pressure lay flat hose coupling, male × female connect to?

faqs.q: How do I fit the high-pressure lay flat hose coupling, male × female to lay flat hose?
faqs.a: To fit the high-pressure lay flat hose coupling, male × female: cut the hose square and push it fully onto the shank before closing the clamp halves. Tighten the clamp bolts evenly, side to side, to the torque given for the size and re-check after the first pressurisation. Match the coupling to the hose wall, since a clamp sized for one wall will not hold another.

faqs.q: Where is the high-pressure lay flat hose coupling, male × female used?
faqs.a: It is used on high-pressure water transfer and frac water lines, oil and fuel transfer with lay flat hose, and high-head dewatering mains. See the [frac water transfer guide](/blog/frac-water-transfer-lay-flat-hose).

faqs.q: How does the high-pressure lay flat hose coupling, male × female compare with the nearest alternative?
faqs.a: A standard large-bore coupling is the weak point on pumped mains, so this version is built for higher pressures. For lower-pressure lines compare the [large-bore male × female coupling](/p/large-bore-male-female-lay-flat-coupling).

faqs.q: What is the large-bore flanged lay flat hose coupling made from?

faqs.q: How do I fit the large-bore flanged lay flat hose coupling to lay flat hose?

faqs.q: What do I send to order the stainless steel well riser hose coupling, 2" to 12"?
faqs.a: Send the riser hose bore, the pump outlet and well-head discharge connections, and the pump weight and depth of the borehole. We confirm suitability with the quotation.

faqs.q: Do you stock the stainless steel well riser hose coupling, 2" to 12" in Dubai?
faqs.a: We keep the stainless steel well riser hose coupling, 2" to 12" in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. We supply it loose or fitted to the hose as an assembly; send size, hose and mating connection through [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Can the stainless steel well riser hose coupling, 2" to 12" be supplied fitted to the hose?
faqs.a: Yes, the stainless steel well riser hose coupling, 2" to 12" can be supplied loose or fitted to the hose as an assembly. Send the hose bore and type, the mating connection at the other end and the working pressure; our [lay flat hose couplings guide](/blog/lay-flat-hose-couplings-guide) explains the choice of coupling.
